sources.title: HYG Database trimmed star catalogues
sources.transformation: scripts/trim_bright_stars.py filters the full HYG catalogue into magnitude tiers and keeps only ra, dec, mag, pmra, pmdec, ci, spect, and proper columns used by SSAPy Toolkit renderers.
sources.notes: The original full catalogue is not redistributed in this package. The preprocessing script verifies retained rows and columns against the local source file when run with --verify.

sources.title: SSAPy Toolkit 2048x1024 Earth viewer texture layers
sources.source_title: matteason/live-cloud-maps Earth, night, specular, and cloud texture products
sources.license: CC0 1.0 Universal for repository code/images, with EUMETSAT attribution required for cloud data and NASA public-domain base imagery
additional_attribution: NASA Earth imagery / Blue Marble base imagery
sources.transformation: scripts/unpack_viewer_textures.py split a legacy SSAPy Toolkit satellite_viewer_textures.npz archive into individual image files with one manifest checksum per texture.
sources.notes: The exact upstream image timestamp from the original texture archive was not recorded. Do not replace or add Earth texture layers without recording the upstream URL, retrieval time, license, and checksum.

sources.title: Earth surface classification raster for solar-body rendering
sources.source_title: NASA Visible Earth Blue Marble imagery
sources.transformation: Compressed NumPy archive containing a 512x1024 uint8 surface-classification raster used by SSAPy Toolkit plotting code.
sources.notes: The generating script and exact source mosaic checksum were not present in this repository when the citation ledger was added. Keep this entry as legacy provenance until the classification can be regenerated from a recorded NASA source image.

sources.title: LRO LOLA 8-pixel-per-degree lunar elevation grid
sources.source_title: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio CGI Moon Kit
sources.transformation: The source unsigned 16-bit TIFF values were decoded as (value - 20000) / 2000 kilometres relative to a 1737.4 km sphere. Each adjacent 2x2 cell block was averaged to reduce the 16-pixel-per-degree source to 8 pixels per degree, then stored as the float32 elev_km array in a compressed NumPy archive.
sources.notes: The packaged grid is an offline input for SSAPy Toolkit's Moon texture baker; generated WebGL textures are not packaged here.

sources.title: Propulsion data source ledger
sources.notes: Propulsion source records, including NASA NTRS table transcriptions, digitized NTRS thrust curves, and ThrustCurve.org public-domain imports, are maintained in propulsion/sources.json.

sources.title: SSATK long-term propagation benchmark state histories
sources.source_title: GMAT R2026a and Orekit 10.3.1 reference propagators
sources.transformation: The benchmark runner records native Cartesian reports from GMAT R2026a RungeKutta89 and Orekit 10.3.1 KeplerianPropagator for matched Earth-centered degree/order-0 point-mass cases. No state interpolation or smoothing is applied.
sources.notes: The cislunar-radius case is an Earth-centered two-body regional comparison and does not represent a full Earth-Moon-Sun dynamical model. GMAT reports km and km/s; Orekit reports m and m/s. This point-mass/Keplerian characterization applies only to the long_term family, not to the separately recorded nbody family; benchmarks/README.md is the suite documentation.

sources.title: SSATK nbody benchmark artifacts; reference-model details pending verification
sources.transformation: Records are grouped by their packaged nbody paths. The supplied patch does not include their input decks or output payloads, so reference force models, frames, units, ephemerides, solver settings, and generation versions have not been independently verified.
sources.notes: Do not inherit the point-mass/Keplerian description of the long_term record. Inspect original benchmark inputs and outputs on the complete repositories before using these artifacts as evidence of nbody validation. No retrieval or generation date is asserted for this newly separated ledger record.

sources.title: Artemis II / Orion maneuver timeline
sources.transformation: Mission-elapsed times from the NASA timeline were stored as integer seconds relative to the documented launch epoch. Event status records NASA as-flown updates where available.
sources.notes: This is a maneuver-event metadata table, not engine telemetry or a reconstructed delta-v solution. Event times are suitable for selecting nearest hourly Horizons samples, not for high-precision ignition modeling.

sources.title: IERS Finals2000A Earth orientation snapshot
sources.source_title: International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service (IERS) Bulletin A
sources.distribution: IERS public scientific distribution; attribution required
sources.license: No SPDX license asserted by the source endpoint
sources.transformation: The original fixed-width 187-byte source file is frozen without numeric transformation; the JSON sidecar records the checksum, field units, byte ranges, and snapshot metadata.
sources.notes: Historical, rapid-service, predicted, and date-only records are retained. Consumers must preserve the I/P status and explicitly opt in to predicted values.

sources.title: CelesTrak Space Weather daily solar and geomagnetic indices
sources.distribution: CelesTrak public space-weather distribution; attribution required
sources.license: No SPDX license asserted by the source endpoint
sources.transformation: The original CSV is frozen without numeric transformation; the JSON sidecar records the checksum and fields used by SSATK.
sources.notes: Observed, interpolated, predicted daily, and predicted monthly records are retained. The NRLMSISE-00 adapter rejects predicted records unless explicitly enabled.

sources.title: JPL DE440 planetary and lunar ephemeris, short kernel (1849-12-26 to 2150-01-22)
sources.license: U.S. Government work (NASA/JPL); no copyright restrictions
sources.transformation: none; scripts/import_ssapy_core_data.py downloads it and checks SHA-256 c1c7feeab882263fc493a9d5a5b2ddd71b54826cdf65d8d17a76126b260a49f2
sources.notes: Replaces the DE430 kernel base SSAPy shipped through Git LFS (119.7 MB, above GitHub's 100 MB file limit). DE440 is consistent with the moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc lunar orientation SSAPy already uses. Park et al. 2021, AJ 161, 105.

sources.title: JPL DE430 planetary and lunar ephemeris, 1900-2150 excerpt
sources.license: U.S. Government work (NASA/JPL); no copyright restrictions
sources.retrieved: not recorded (packaged with llnl-ssapy <= 1.1.10; identical to NAIF's de430.bsp, SHA-256 6e1b277c...fca1)
sources.transformation: python -m jplephem excerpt 1900/1/1 2150/1/1 de430.bsp de430_1900_2150.bsp (the full kernel, 119.7 MB, exceeds GitHub's 100 MB file limit). The excerpt keeps DE430's Chebyshev records for 1900-2150; positions agree with the full kernel to 4e-13 relative.
sources.notes: Kept so results made with SSAPy <= 1.1.10 (DE430) can be reproduced; SSAPy downloads the full de430.bsp from NAIF for epochs outside 1900-2150.
